pitchEmail.subject: Partnership Opportunity for Jeremy Peña fans in Houston
pitchEmail.body: Hello community leaders and supporters, We are organizing a blood drive campaign in Houston running through Sun, Dec 13, with a goal of reaching 300 donors. We would love to engage Jeremy Peña fans to help support this life-saving cause. Our upcoming drive takes place at the Julia Ideson Building on Sat, Nov 14. We are asking local groups to help spread the word to fans about checking their eligibility and coming out to donate. Please note that this is an independent community blood drive and is not officially endorsed by or affiliated with any team or athlete. Thank you for considering sharing this opportunity with Jeremy Peña fans.
